name: Cetirizine Hydrochloride
contraindications_original: Cetirizine hydrochloride oral solution USP, 1 mg/mL can be taken without regard to food consumption.
warningsAndPrecautions_original:
Cetirizine hydrochloride oral solution USP, 5 mg/5 mL (1 mg/mL) is colorless to slightly yellow with a banana-grape flavor. Each teaspoonful (5 mL) contains 5 mg cetirizine hydrochloride.
                  Cetirizine hydrochloride oral solution is supplied as follows:
                  120 mL plastic bottles NDC 68788-8282-1
adverseReactions_original: Cetirizine hydrochloride is contraindicated in those patients with a known hypersensitivity to it or any of its ingredients or hydroxyzine.
